title: Run a KYB check once — refuse the re-check
narrative: A pending business onboarding can run a paid bureau check; KIFF allows it and signs a receipt. The app records the result and marks the business verified. When the workflow re-enters and tries to run the check again, KIFF refuses it — RUN_KYB_CHECK is only allowed from PENDING — so the paid verification runs exactly once, even on a retried workflow.

steps.description: The workflow runs the paid bureau check. Allowed — the business is PENDING. Signed receipt.
The result is recorded and the business is verified (state → VERIFIED).
A retried workflow step runs the check again. KIFF refuses it (state_not_allowed) — no double bureau charge. Signed refusal.
